name: Indy 500
unique: The largest single-day sporting event in the world: 300,000 people, a brick start-finish line, and a century of tradition from the milk bottle to the snake pit.
buzz: Even non-fans are converted by the spectacle; bring ear protection and arrive early. The infield is a party, the stands are the racing.

name: Holiday World
unique: The world's first theme park, still family-owned, with free unlimited soda, free sunscreen and two of the best water coasters on earth.
buzz: Parents rave about the free perks and clean park; the Thanksgiving-themed rides are charming. It is a genuine value.

name: Turkey Run State Park
unique: Deep sandstone canyons with ladders, a suspension bridge and hemlock gullies, plus a Sugar Creek canoe run that is the best float in the state.
buzz: Hoosiers call it their favorite park; Trail 3 is the classic. Canoe rentals fill up on summer weekends.

name: Indiana Dunes
unique: A national park of 15 miles of Lake Michigan beach, 200-foot dunes and black oak savanna, an hour from Chicago.
buzz: The 3 Dune Challenge is a real workout with a great view; the beach is the cleanest near Chicago. Summer parking fills by 9am.

name: Shipshewana Auction and Flea Market
unique: An Amish-run livestock auction and a thousand-vendor flea market where you can buy a horse, a pie and a hand-forged tool in the same morning.
buzz: The auction is the real show; get there at 8am for the horses. The flea market is enormous and the food is excellent.
